title: ecmwf-multi-agents settings
description: Settings for the ecmwf-multi-agents agents in opencode, in ecmwf-multi-agents.jsonc. The file is read from the opencode config directory and then from a project's .opencode/ directory: project values override global ones, and agents entries merge per agent. Leave a setting out to keep its default.

$schema.title: Schema
$schema.description: Path or URL of this schema, so editors can check the file and suggest values.

review.title: Review policy
review.description: When the reviewer checks plans and changes. Default: auto. auto: plans are reviewed before you approve them, and changes beyond a trivial edit are reviewed. ask: lead asks you each time. always: every plan and every change is reviewed. never: nothing is reviewed unless you ask with /review.

profile.title: Model profile
profile.description: Which models the agents use. Default: default. anthropic: Anthropic models only. The reviewer and the tester use the strongest model, since a different family is not available. copilot: GitHub Copilot models only, with the same split as the default profile. default: Anthropic for lead, scout and builder; GitHub Copilot GPT for the reviewer and the tester, so they check work with a different model family. inherit: Every agent uses the model selected in the session. Helpers still differ by step limit.

default_agent.title: Start in lead
default_agent.description: Make lead the agent opencode starts with. Default: true. Set false to keep opencode's own default agent; you can still switch to lead with Tab.

max_helper_slots.title: Helper slots
max_helper_slots.description: The most helpers lead may run at once. Default: 4. Whole number of at least 1. More slots can run more builds, dev servers and databases on the same machine.

agents.title: Per-agent settings
agents.description: Helpers switched on or off, and model, reasoning effort and step limit for single agents, applied after the profile.

lead.title: lead
lead.description: Talks to you, plans, hands work to helpers and checks the results. Start here. Settings here override the profile for lead.

model.title: Model
model.description: Model for lead, written as provider/model, for example anthropic/claude-opus-5-5. No "#" and no spaces. Leave it out to use the profile's choice.

effort.title: Reasoning effort
effort.description: Reasoning effort for the model of lead. Common values: low, medium, high, xhigh and max; some models also take none. Default: xhigh, from the default profile. It applies only when lead has a model, from the profile or from this entry, so it has no effect under the inherit profile unless this entry also names a model. No "#" and no spaces. Leave it out to use the profile's choice.

fallback.title: Fallback models
fallback.description: Models lead tries, in order, when its own model is not usable. Each entry is provider/model, or an object with "model" and an optional "effort". Needs a model in this same entry. Setting a model without a fallback list drops the profile's list; an empty list means no fallbacks. A list here replaces any list from the profile or from an earlier settings file.

items.title: Fallback model
items.description: A model, or a model with its reasoning effort.

oneOf.title: Model
oneOf.description: Written as provider/model. No "#" and no spaces.

oneOf.title: Model with effort
oneOf.description: A fallback model and the reasoning effort to use on it.

model.title: Model
model.description: Written as provider/model. No "#" and no spaces.

effort.title: Reasoning effort
effort.description: Reasoning effort for this model, such as "high". No "#" and no spaces. Leave it out for the model's own default.

steps.title: Step limit
steps.description: Most model turns lead may take before it stops and reports. A whole number of at least 1. Default: no limit.
